Run yul_yyz_scraper.py against the same travel dates on different days (e.g. daily via cron), then load all the resulting CSVs here at once.

One scrape only shows one price point — this view needs at least 2-3 runs on different days before a trend means anything.
Each card tracks one specific (travel date + airport) combination across every time it was scraped. "Scraped on" is the run timestamp the scraper stamped on that row. Δ is the change from the previous scrape for that same combination, not from the first ever scrape.
